settings.description: The v0.8 verdict's combination check (spec/V0.8-DECISIONS.md, "The v0.8 verdict", #140), on tune only: the arms D1, D3 and D6 adopted, each alone and in every combination a cell can hold, so each (code, alpha mode) cell's combination is read against its best single arm under R2 with delta 1.0%. Each single copies its frozen arm's tune string unchanged (entropy-coded-ac-frozen, synthesis-window-codes34-frozen, alpha-tiers34-frozen). A combination is the union of its components' strings; D1 with D6 codes the stream with bounds of three times the D6 row at its widths, the x3 D1 froze. D6 strings move only alpha-mode hashes. t2 shipped is D3's spurious floor. Rows across codes are at different byte counts and are not judged; stratify --combination reads each cell over its own images.
